visual_qa.method: Rendered the generated SVG atlases to raster previews and visually checked species recognition, comparison separation, silhouette/readability and consistency.
visual_qa.override_reason: Their base low/mid/high panels were too similar at catalogue-card scale. The override atlas makes the real quality axes more legible without inventing new species traits.

quality_logic.pattern_first: Green Phantom, White Phantom, Bloodstone, Mixed Rutilated Quartz
quality_logic.optical_effect_first: Labradorite, Rainbow Moonstone, Tiger's Eye, Rainbow Obsidian
quality_logic.pearls: luster + surface + roundness/form + body color/overtone; not supplier AA/AAA

repo_state_note: Generated SVG assets are actual repository assets and can be consumed by the Workbench now. Licensed real-photo cutout assets can be added later as an enhancement layer when binary transfer is available.
next_action: Do not continue broad source discovery. Review these assets in the Workbench at actual card size; only refine a material when recognition or grade separation is concretely insufficient.
